title: Linux Program Manager
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management

General Summary:

The Linux Program Manager will own the end‑to‑end program execution for Qualcomm Linux platform activities, with a focus on upstreaming, open‑sourcing, kernel/mainline alignment, distro enablement, and branch lifecycle management. The role requires strong cross‑functional leadership, deep familiarity with Linux development models, and the ability to drive multi‑team execution across kernel, Yocto, Debian/Ubuntu, user‑space frameworks, CI, and product teams.

Key Responsibilities

Upstreaming Program Management -

Mainline & Branch Lifecycle Management

Open‑Source Compliance & Release Coordination

Linux Distribution Enablement & Ecosystem Alignment

  • Coordinate Yocto, Debian, Ubuntu, and other distro enablement workstreams (graphics, multimedia, AI/ML, connectivity, robotics, etc.).

Cross‑Functional Program Leadership

  • Manage execution across kernel, multimedia, Android, and other participating orgs.
    Own program schedules, risk tracking, dependency management, reviews, and executive reporting.

  • Ensure teams follow developer‑first, Linux‑first best practices, including frequent mainline/Yocto upgrades.

Quality, Testing & Automation Oversight

  • Ensure pre‑merge testing, LBT automation, and continuous validation across mainline and LTS branches.
    Track quality issues across feature requests and ensure cross‑team closure.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10-15+ years of experience in Linux/Kernel/Yocto/OSS ecosystems, with program or technical leadership roles.

  • Strong technical understanding of:

    • Upstream Linux development model (maintainers, reviewers, linux‑next, stable trees).

  • Kernel branching policies, mainline alignment, LTS workflows.
    Yocto/Open Embedded, Debian/Ubuntu, and other Linux distros.
    Open‑source contribution processes, submitting patches, Gerrit/Git workflows.
    Experience working across large cross‑functional engineering organizations.

  • Excellent communication, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• 2+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

title: IE IoT Software Program Manager – Linux & Industrial Solutions
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management

General Summary:

IE Io T Software Program Manager – Linux & Industrial Solutions

Role Overview

The IE Io T Software Program Manager is responsible for driving end‑to‑end execution of Qualcomm’s Linux platform initiatives with a strong emphasis on upstream alignment, open-source excellence, distribution enablement, lifecycle management, and the productization of industrial‑grade Io T solutions.

This role demands exceptional cross‑functional leadership, deep expertise in embedded Linux development ecosystems, and the ability to orchestrate execution across kernel, Yocto, Debian/Ubuntu, user‑space frameworks, CI pipelines, and industrial solution teams. A customer‑first approach, cost‑efficient decision making, and proven experience transforming prototypes into robust, production‑ready industrial solutions are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Linux Platform & Upstream Leadership

  • Define and lead mainline alignment, upstreaming strategies, and branch lifecycle management across mainline, LTS, and stable trees.
  • Oversee open‑source compliance, release coordination, and adherence to Qualcomm’s Linux‑first execution strategy.
  • Ensure predictable upstream refresh cadences across kernel, Yocto, and Debian/Ubuntu ecosystems

Distro Enablement & Ecosystem Integration

  • Drive end‑to‑end enablement across Yocto, Debian, and Ubuntu distributions, including graphics, multimedia, AI/ML, connectivity, robotics, and industrial frameworks.
  • Champion developer‑first workflows, upstream‑friendly integration practices, and clear, high‑quality open‑source documentation.

Productization & Industrial Io T Solution Readiness

  • Convert platform capabilities and prototypes into stable, repeatable, production‑grade industrial Io T solutions.
  • Integrate key industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, Ether CAT, Profinet, MQTT, Co AP, etc.) into platform roadmaps and solution blueprints.
  • Drive cost‑optimized decision making across feature sets, cloud usage, and hardware/software selections.

Customer Engagement & Solutions Engineering

  • Maintain strong customer focus—translate customer needs into actionable, prioritized engineering workflows.
  • Lead solution prototyping, Po Cs, and integration efforts by coordinating across functional teams.
  • Deliver developer‑grade documentation, solution guides, and production‑ready reference implementations.

Cross‑Functional Program Leadership

  • Manage large cross‑functional execution spanning kernel, multimedia, Android, connectivity, user space, and partner teams that includes the HW platform teams.
  • Own schedules, milestone alignment, dependency mapping, risk management, and executive communications.
  • Ensure Linux‑first, developer‑first discipline across the entire engineering pipeline.

Quality, Testing & Automation Excellence

  • Drive strong pre‑merge validation, CI/CD health, and continuous testing coverage across mainline and LTS branches.
  • Track quality regressions across features, drive closure with partner teams, and uphold production‑readiness KPIs.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 10–15+ years of leadership experience within embedded Linux/Kernel/Yocto/Open‑Source ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of:
    • Upstream Linux development workflows (maintainers, linux‑next, LTS/stable branches).
    • Kernel branching models, mainline alignment, Yocto/OE pipelines, and Debian/Ubuntu packaging and workflows.
    • Open‑source contribution processes (patch submission, review cycles, Gerrit/Git workflows).
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi‑disciplinary engineering programs.
  • Exceptional communication skills and strong stakeholder management with a risk‑driven decision mindset.

Preferred

  • Experience with industrial Io T systems, industrial protocols, or Linux‑based industrial platforms.
  • Background in prototyping, customer‑facing engineering, or productizing industrial Io T software stacks.
  • Strong documentation and developer ecosystem orientation.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• 4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

title: Engineer - Linux Kernel Development
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

​Job function:

Work on Linux Kernel development for enabling and supporting Qualcomm Snapdragon Chipsets and products

Skills/experience:

  • 1-3 years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
  • Excellent knowledge of OS fundamentals, data structure, Linux kernel and the device driver model
  • Excellent programming skills and expert level knowledge of C
  • Specific experience and expertise in any of kernel subsystems – core kernel, device drivers, memory, SMMU, ARM subsystems etc.
  • Highly skilled in debug using any debugger like T32, gdb and crash analysis sing T32, crash utility etc.
  • Expert in using tracing and other related tools to identify performance bottlenecks and solve them
  • Well versed with other development tools like tool chain, version control etc.
  • Background experience in Android is a plus
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work with cross teams to develop and support various features in Linux kernel to support Android on Qualcomm Snapdragon Chipsets
  • Work on latest bleeding edge ARMv9 CPUs and features
  • Closely work with power and performance to analyze and identify performance bottlenecks and implement optimizations.
  • Enable and support other teams that use supported Linux kernel features
  • Identify and support core set of tools for assisting Linux Kernel development, debug and support
  • Education requirements: Bachelors or Masters in CS or ECE

title: Workfront Fusion Developer
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Programmer Analyst

General Summary:

We’re looking for a hands‑on Workfront Fusion Developer to join our Marketing Technology team to deliver automation solutions that power workflows across our enterprise marketing systems, enabling our team to work smarter. In this role, you’ll design, implement, and optimize scalable Workfront Fusion / Workfront Core solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, a background in integrations and automation, and excellent communication skills to work closely with stakeholders. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on our marketing operations while working with industry-leading Adobe technologies.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

    • Create, test, design, and deploy automation workflows and integrations using Workfront Fusion to streamline processes and enhance data flow between enterprise systems
    • Assist in collaborating with business and technical teams to gather requirements and translate into scalable technical solutions
    • Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve integration issues to maintain seamless workflow operations
    • Serve as a trusted technical advisor on end-to-end Workfront integrations, providing strategic guidance on best practices and optimization opportunities
    • Develop and configure custom workflows, templates, forms, request queues, approval processes, and dashboards within Workfront Core to support marketing team efficiency
    • Configure and maintain user roles, permissions, and access controls to ensure secure and appropriate system access across the marketing organization
    • Implement and manage integrations between Workfront and Adobe Experience Cloud, including AEM Assets (DAM), ensuring seamless content and asset management across platforms
    • Stay current with the latest Adobe Workfront Fusion features, updates, and best practices within the broader Adobe ecosystem

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

    • Advanced communication skills in English
    • 5+ years of hands-on work experience developing and managing scenarios and automations with Workfront Fusion
    • Strong proficiency in Adobe Workfront Core configuration, setup, and administration
    • Demonstrated experience integrating AEM Assets (DAM) with Workfront and other enterprise systems
      Deep comprehension of project management workflows
    • Proven track record supporting enterprise-scale marketing technology implementations
    • Solid understanding of REST APIs, custom API integrations, JSON, and webhooks
    • Experience with Workfront Planning
    • Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud
    • Workfront certification
    • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
    • Clear communication skills; ability to work across global, cross-functional teams

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• 3+ years of work experience in programming, scripting, and/or automation or IT-relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree.
OR
5+ years of work experience in programming, scripting, and/or automation or IT-relevant work experience without a Bachelor’s degree.

• 1+ year of experience with Database Design structures such as Mongo DB, My SQL.

Qualcomm, a leader in next-generation wireless and multimedia technology, is seeking a passionate Electroacoustics Engineer to join our Advanced Tech R&D team. jobDescription:
Company:

Job Area:

General Summary:

Job Overview

As part of Qualcomm’s Audio and Low-Power AI (LPAI) Architecture group, you will architect, analyze, and optimize DSP and embedded NPU (e NPU) performance across Snapdragon value-tier platforms. Your focus will be on architectural analysis, optimization, and deployment of low-power AI (LPAI) solutions, enabling efficient on-device intelligence, including e NPU scheduling, memory hierarchy, compression/quantization strategies, and clock/BW voting, to enable efficient on-device AI for audio, sensors, and always-on use cases. You will build system models, conduct performance/power trade studies, and drive architectural recommendations that scale across mobile, XR, compute, Io T, and automotive tiers

Key Responsibilities

· Analyze, design, and optimize LPAI (Hexagon DSP, e NPU, TCM/UBUF/LLC/DDR) for performance, power, and area efficiency in value tier chipsets.

· Conduct architectural analysis and benchmarking of LPAI subsystems, identifying bottlenecks and proposing solutions for improved throughput and efficiency.

· Collaborate with hardware and software teams to define and implement enhancements in DSP/e NPU microarchitecture, memory hierarchy, and dataflow.

· Develop and validate performance models for AI workloads, including signal processing and ML inference, on embedded platforms.

· Prototype and evaluate new architectural features for LPAI, including quantization, compression, and hardware acceleration techniques.

· Support system-level integration, performance testing, and demo prototyping for commercialization of optimized DSP/e NPU solutions.

· Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment and commercialization of value tier chipset features.

· Document architectural analysis, optimization strategies, and performance results for internal and external stakeholders.

Requirements

· Solid background in DSP architecture, embedded NPU design, and low-power AI systems.

· Proven experience in performance analysis, benchmarking, and optimization of embedded processors (DSP, NPU, ARM, RISC-V).

· Strong fundamentals of Power modeling and Power analysis

· Experience working on System level power anlaysis and measurements

· Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++, Python familiarity with performance modeling tools.

· Experience with embedded platforms, real-time operating systems, and hardware/software co-design.

· Expertise in both fixed-point and floating-point implementation, with a focus on ML/AI workloads.

· Excellent communication, presentation, and teamwork skills; ability to work independently and across global teams.

Educational Qualifications

· Master’s or Ph D degree in Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Electrical, Computer Science, or related field.

· Familiarity with Qualcomm DSP/e NPU architectures, SDKs, and tools.

· Experience with LPAI frameworks and design.

title: Engineer, Senior Staff - Audio Drivers
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

The Senior Staff Engineer – Audio is a senior technical leadership role responsible for defining, architecting, and delivering complex audio technologies across platforms and products. This role owns end‑to‑end audio features—from requirements and system design through implementation, optimization, validation, and production support—while influencing technical direction across teams.
The individual is expected to work independently with minimal supervision, provide technical leadership to engineers and consultants, and collaborate closely with cross‑functional partners including product management, platform, and customer engineering teams.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  • Own architecture and system‑level design for complex audio features and subsystems across software, DSP, and platform layers (e.g., audio frameworks, HALs, DSP pipelines, audio effects, routing, and performance optimization).
  • Translate product and use‑case requirements into clear technical designs, HLDs/LLDs, and implementation plans, including APIs, control/data flows, threading models, and timing constraints.
  • Drive design trade‑offs related to audio quality, latency, power, memory, and system performance.
Development & Delivery
  • Lead implementation of high‑quality, production‑ready audio software and/or DSP components using best‑in‑class engineering practices.
  • Ensure features are fully validated through unit tests, integration tests, system tests, and customer validation flows before release.
  • Guide code integration and release into build/test/release pipelines, tracking progress through internal validation and post‑customer support phases.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate with product owners and program leads to plan and execute audio roadmaps, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Partner with platform, DSP, hardware, and system teams to enable end‑to‑end audio solutions across devices and form factors.
  • Support customer and partner engagements by providing deep technical insight, debugging, and solution guidance when required.
Mentorship & Technical Influence
  • Provide technical mentorship and design guidance to senior, mid‑level, and junior engineers, including consultants and temporary staff.
  • Lead design and code reviews, driving feedback to closure and raising the overall engineering quality bar.
  • Influence broader organizational technical decisions by contributing to standards, best practices, and long‑term architectural direction.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Significant industry experience in audio software, DSP, multimedia systems, or embedded platforms.
  • Strong expertise in one or more of the following:
  • Audio frameworks and pipelines (e.g., Android audio stack, ALSA, ASo C, or equivalent)
  • DSP audio processing, algorithms, and optimization
  • Low‑latency, real‑time, and power‑efficient audio systems
  • Proficiency in systems programming languages such as C/C++ (and scripting languages where applicable).
  • Proven experience owning complex technical features end‑to‑end with minimal supervision.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cross‑OS or cross‑platform audio solutions (mobile, automotive, Io T, XR, or embedded systems).
  • Hands‑on experience with performance profiling, latency analysis, and power optimization for audio workloads.
  • Prior experience influencing technical direction beyond immediate team scope or acting as a vertical/area owner.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Role Expectations & Impact
  • Operates independently and makes technically sound decisions with moderate organizational impact.
  • Recognized as a go‑to expert for audio technology within the organization.
  • Errors, if any, are typically detected through established review and validation processes and have limited business impact, though they may require cross‑team coordination to resolve.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

• 3+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

General Summary:

Looking for self-sufficient motivated individuals, experienced in System Testing at various levels of Cellular Products.

This is an excellent opportunity to work on cutting edge technology and join a dynamic team in the process of building next-generation end-to-end systems for 5G NR.

You can expect to be a part of a project having global impact contributing to the latest ideas and developments in Mobile Wireless, working with world leading experts.


You will be involved in the Integration and Validation of the large SW systems that are part of advanced 5G NR g NB infrastructure with focus on DU and RU solutions including RF, PHY, MAC protocols and layers. You will be required to perform various duties in Software Test Life Cycle (STLC) such as test planning, integration, execution, and automation of the Qualcomm g NB L1 solution using Qualcomm RU and DU platforms. The candidate will also be involved in very low level details of the n FAPI, ORAN and 3GPP specifications for functional, stability, and conformance testing.

Job also involves log analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, JIRA/CR ticketing, Stability and Performance activities. This position will expose you to Qualcomm’s cutting edge So C, HW platforms, as well as the 5G NR system specifications.

Candidates must have great interest in new technologies, proactive, willing to learn and working in a lab environment with hands-on approach to work assignments.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills are required to collaborate well within same or across geographical locations in a technical environment.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

Minimum Qualifications

· Good Analytical and Social Communication Skills.

· Acumen to read and understand the 3GPP specifications and come up with innovative test design and methodologies using industry standard equipment.

· Strong fundamentals in Wireless communications, Digital Signal Processing, Information & Coding Theory.

· 0-3 years of test experience in one or more of following radio access technologies.

o 5G NR, LTE, UMTS, Wifi with focus on RRC, RLC, MAC, PHY, RF testing, Network functions.

· Experience with test equipment such as channel emulator, spectrum analyzers and signal generators, real UEs, and network entities.

· Preferred Qualifications

· Experience working in design and development of 5G NR/ LTE g NB/e NB RF/PHY layer testing scenarios and/or ORAN and n FAPI specification testing scenarios is preferable

jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Test Engineering

General Summary:

Tests and modifies general systems-level software/hardware, specialized utility and/or hardware. Interprets wireless specifications. Designs test plans, scenarios, scripts, or procedures. Documents systems-level defects, using a bug tracking system, and report defects to developers. Identifies, analyzes, troubleshoots, and documents problems with program function, output, or content. Develops testing programs that assess effectiveness of a new system or modification of an existing system.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• 4+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

Principal Duties and RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Conducts log analyses to identify where an issue has occurred and makes recommendations for how to address the issue.
• Understands basic features of the system.
• Collects information (e.g., logs, requirements) and identifies basic patterns/trends related to systems testing.
• Manages individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables with minimal supervision.
• Determines which work tasks are most important for self and junior engineers, avoids distractions, and completes work in a timely manner.
• Communicates detailed and regular feedback about identified feature issues to software and systems teams.
• Collaborates with individuals inside own team and with other teams to complete project work.
• Resolves straightforward technical issues and escalates to technical leads as necessary.
• Adapts to significant changes and setbacks in order to manage pressure and meet deadlines.
• Gathers, integrates, and interprets information from a variety of sources in order to troubleshoot issues and find solutions.
• Detects bugs in the "system under test" and resolves issues using more advanced debugging approaches.
• Conducts more advanced field or lab tests as directed by tech leads.
• Seeks opinions of others within own team about ways in which a problem can be addressed differently.

Level of Responsibility:

• Working under some supervision.
• Making decisions that are moderate in impact; errors may have relatively minor financial impact or effect on projects, operations, or customer relationships; errors may require involvement beyond immediate work group to correct.
• Using verbal and written communication skills to convey information that may be somewhat complex to others who may have limited knowledge of the subject in question. May require basic negotiation and influence, cooperation, tact, and diplomacy, etc.
• Having a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to provide input on key decisions).
• Completing tasks with multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; some planning and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively; mistakes may result in some rework.
• Exercising creativity to draft original documents, imagery, or work products within established guidelines.
• Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or incomplete; intermediate data analysis/interpretation skills may be required.
• May be solicited during strategic planning period.

• Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).

title: Senior Engineer - AI Agentic Fuzzing & Linux Security
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

Senior Engineer – AI Agentic Fuzzing & Linux Security

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to contribute to the area of Linux platform security, with a focus on AI-driven automated fuzzing and continuous security assurance across embedded and mobile platforms. The person will be responsible for designing and deploying intelligent fuzzing infrastructure, developing fuzzing harnesses using agentic AI frameworks, performing security risk assessments, and conducting secure code reviews for Linux kernel and driver stacks.

The ideal candidate possesses a strong security-first mindset, hands-on experience with industry-leading fuzzers, and a passion for leveraging AI/LLM-based agentic frameworks to scale and automate vulnerability discovery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-agent-driven fuzzing harnesses targeting Linux kernel subsystems, device drivers, and system interfaces using frameworks such as Lang Chain, Agno, Auto Gen, or similar agentic orchestration tools.
  • Build and maintain continuous fuzzing pipelines (e.g., OSS-Fuzz, QSS-Fuzz, Cluster Fuzz) integrated into CI/CD workflows for automated vulnerability detection.
  • Develop and tune fuzzing campaigns using popular fuzzers including Syzkaller, lib Fuzzer, AFL++ and custom mutation strategies.
  • Perform security risk assessments and threat modeling on Linux platform components, kernel modules, and firmware interfaces.
  • Conduct thorough secure code reviews to identify memory corruption, privilege escalation, race conditions, and other vulnerability classes (CWEs).
  • Triage and analyze crash reports, root-cause security bugs, and coordinate patch development with owning teams.
  • Research and prototype LLM-assisted harness generation, enabling near-autonomous fuzzing target creation for new codebases.
  • Collaborate with platform, kernel, and security teams to integrate security requirements across the Security Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate also needs to have:

  • Strong knowledge of Linux kernel internals — memory management, scheduling, IPC, syscall interface, and kernel security mechanisms (LSM, seccomp, namespaces).
  • Deep expertise in Linux device driver development (character devices, platform drivers, PCIe, USB, UART, etc.) and driver debugging.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks and the ability to build autonomous agents that reason over codebases to generate and evolve fuzz targets.
  • Experience deploying continuous fuzzing infrastructure at scale — job scheduling, corpus management, crash deduplication, and coverage-guided optimization.
  • Proficiency with Syzkaller — syscall description writing, syzbot integration, repro analysis, and custom grammar extension.
  • Strong secure code review skills with ability to identify vulnerability patterns in C/C++ codebases.
  • Familiarity with firmware security — UEFI, BIOS, Trust Zone/TEE, and secure boot chains is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and cross-team communication skills.

title: Engineer- Python Developement,QA-ML
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

Company Overview
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

Role Overview
As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud-edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world-class products that meet and exceed customer needs.
Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.

Join a new and growing team at Qualcomm focused on advancing the state of the art in machine learning. The team uses Qualcomm chips’ extensive heterogeneous computing capabilities and engineers them to enable the execution of trained neural networks on device without the need for a cloud connection.
You will work with the latest DNNs emerging from the research community and keep pace with fast-moving developments in industry and academia to continuously enhance benchmarking and validation infrastructure from both software engineering and machine learning perspectives.

• Experience in Electron-based application testing across multiple operating systems (Windows, Linux, mac OS).
• Experience with testing frameworks such as Jasmine and Playwright (for Electron JS–based desktop applications).
• Strong development skills in Python.
• Strong understanding of machine learning and deep learning workflows.
• Experience with at least one machine learning framework such as Tensor Flow or Py Torch.
• Excellent communication skills (verbal, presentation, and written).
• Strong problem-solving, time management, analytical, and debugging skills.
• Ability to work effectively as a team member and operate in a self-driven manner.
Preferred Qualifications
• Strong exposure to software testing methodologies and reporting.
• Experience with CI tools such as Jenkins and data visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
Work Experience
• 1 to 2 years of relevant work experience in software development or test development.

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.

title: RTL Design (Director)
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary:

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• 15+ years of So C design, verification, synthesis / implementation related work experience

  • Thorough understanding of Digital design concepts
  • Knowledge of state of the art So C design flows
  • Experience in delivering RTL2GDSII
  • Good understanding of ARM based So C architectures would be a plus
  • Understanding of Bus protocols like AHB/AXI/ACE/ACE-Lite

• 5+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Vice President level and above).

Principal Duties and RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Holds team accountable and provides technical expertise and support to team members to ensure architecture and design tasks are completed on time.

• Leads complex implementation strategy development that meets system requirements and customer needs for team.

• Acts as the technical expert in resolving highly complex architecture, design, or verification problems when provided with incomplete, ambiguous or conflicting requirements.

• Holds team accountable and provides technical expertise for the design and verification strategies of the IP core team members to ensure customer and program needs are met.

• Directs team to add additional test cases when necessary to ensure that the most complex bugs are fully understood and analyzed.

• Provides technical expertise and support to team members to ensure power checks are completed on time.

• Reviews the process of interpreting reports derived from performance checks for various blocks to ensure potential obstacles are identified and provides a mitigation plan for identified issues.

• Acts as a tech lead on innovative technologies to drive advances; influences standards.

• Reviews technical documentation for large projects before publication and provides feedback on the documentation, and requirements as needed.

• Serves as a technical lead by participating in cross-functional groups to ensure a feasible product execution path and communicates this path to team.

• Drives technical conversation in design or project reviews and project meetings and ensures cross functional team alignment on project tasks, and best interests are represented.

• Acts as a tech lead on major projects to ensure they are driven to completion (e.g. timely, on budget).

• Learns and applies lessons from past projects; acts as a tech lead in the recommendation and implementation of improved and/or new engineering procedures.

• Identifies technical opportunities or projects inside of Qualcomm and secures resources as necessary.

Additional responsibilities might include:

• Provides technical expertise and support to team members to define and make available foundry technology roadmap choices to meet product requirements

• Leads team to define and develop competitive and timely foundry technology to fit product roadmap.

• Leads resolution of critical technology and design-technology interaction issues to execute on timely Product ramp.

Level of Responsibility:

• Working independently with no supervision.

• Making decisions that are significant in impact, influencing overall program or organization success, finances, and/or the ability to meet objectives; errors are not readily apparent due to the complexity of work process/product or time between decisions and results; errors typically result in significant expenditure of time, resources, and funds to correct.

• Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple individuals/audiences with differing knowledge levels. May require strong negotiation and influence, communication to large groups or high-level constituents.

• Having a great degree of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is making or directly making key decisions that have substantial impact on the organization).

• Completing tasks that require multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; tasks require simultaneously executing multiple cognitive abilities and maintaining information in short or long-term memory.

• Regularly determines what needs to be done and is involved with sharing innovative solutions to achieve broad policies and objectives.

• Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or conflicting; advanced data analysis and interpretation skills are required.

• Occasionally participates in strategic planning within own area affecting immediate operations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 7+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

title: Synthesis- Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary:

Qualcomm Chennai is seeking a highly motivated Synthesis (Design Implementation) Engineer to drive synthesis and low-power implementation for complex So C and subsystem designs. The candidate will work closely with Design, Physical Design, DFT, and Timing teams to achieve competitive Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) targets on advanced technology nodes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage synthesis deliverables across multiple blocks/subsystems, ensuring schedule, quality, and tape out commitments are met.
  • Mentor and technically guide team members on timing closure, UPF methodologies, advanced-node implementation challenges, and debug strategies
  • Drive execution reviews, risk assessment, and closure plans for project milestones.
  • Coordinate across RTL, DFT, Physical Design, STA, and Verification teams to resolve cross-functional issues and improve design convergence.
  • Define and drive synthesis methodologies, best practices, and flow improvements across the team.
  • Contribute to resource planning, execution tracking, and prioritization of team deliverables.
  • Run quality checks including check_design, check_timing, Lint, CDC, ERC, and support MTBF-related fixes.

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Physical and low power aware synthesis using Synopsys Fusion Compiler/Design Compiler or Cadence Genus.
  • Implement and validate UPF-based low-power architectures, including isolation cells, level shifters, retention cells, and power switches
  • Develop and maintain SDC constraints, perform Pre-STA analysis, and drive pre-layout timing convergence.
  • Expertise in Prime Time/Tempus, UPF, CLP, and Formality/Conformal/Conformal ECO.
  • Good understanding of multi-voltage designs, low-power methodologies, and timing closure
  • Develop automation and flow improvements using AI agents, TCL, Perl, Python, and Shell scripting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience on advanced nodes (6nm/5nm/4nm/3nm or equivalent).
  • Ownership of synthesis for blocks/subsystems with 2M+ cells.
  • Expertise in UPF, Multi voltage Designs, POCV/AOCV and variation-aware high speed timing analysis.
  • Experience with flat-level signoff flows, LEC, CLP and physical synthesis methodologies.
  • Ability to independently drive synthesis and low-power closure through tape out
  • IO timing closure

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

title: AI, Machine Learning & Data Science Engineering Leads
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm is shaping next‑generation intelligent and connected experiences. We are seeking multiple highly skilled Machine Learning & Data Science Engineers who can independently drive end‑to‑end development of scalable data pipelines, ML/NLP models, and production‑grade Python systems.

These roles require strong technical depth across Machine Learning, NLP, Data Engineering, and Python backend development, along with the ability to work autonomously and deliver high‑impact solutions.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Machine Learning & NLP

  • Develop, fine‑tune, and deploy ML and NLP models using Tensor Flow, Py Torch, and Scikit‑learn.
  • Apply advanced NLP methods including Transformers, BERT‑based models, and LLM fine‑tuning.
  • Build Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Lang Chain, Llama Index, FAISS, Milvus, etc.
  • Work with model registries and cloud ML environments (Hugging Face, AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML).

Data Engineering & Infrastructure

  • Design and implement scalable ETL and data ingestion pipelines using SQL, No SQL, and big‑data frameworks (Spark, Hadoop, Py Spark).
  • Build efficient data models, schema designs, and storage strategies (Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Cassandra, etc.).
  • Ensure data quality, validation, and governance across distributed systems.
  • Own documentation and architecture of data flows.

Python Development

  • Develop scalable backend components and services using Python (Fast API, Flask, Django).
  • Automate workflows, model pipelines, and data processing using Pandas, Num Py, SQLAlchemy.
  • Integrate ML solutions into production systems with clean, modular, well‑documented code.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Work independently to design, build, and deliver complete ML/Data solutions.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams including systems, hardware, architects, and test teams.
  • Translate business requirements into technical approaches and drive execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field.
  • 4–15 years of experience across ML, NLP, and Data Engineering.
  • Expert‑level Python programming with hands‑on experience in backend/API development.
  • Strong knowledge of ML/NLP algorithms, LLMs, and RAG frameworks.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with SQL/No SQL databases.
  • Experience with big data tools such as Spark or Hadoop.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).
  • Strong communication, analytical, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take end‑to‑end ownership of solutions.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

• 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

Infra Systems Architect for the next generation System-on-chip (So C) for smartphones, Compute, AI accelerators and other product categories. This position will be responsible for

  • Technical and hands on role mainly for high level architecture and micro-architecture development.

  • Building Design prototypes for advance IPs in system infrastructure domain, creating experiments to test proof of concept for algo efficiency, initial analysis on power, area or latency benefits

  • learning various facets of SOC architecture from High-speed Interconnect, Bus Protocols, Memory Technologies, Power Architecture to support different segments of infra solutions

  • Working with Performance modelling team to prototype new IP ideas, and with Silicon team to analyze prior products and competition

  • Understanding of ARM architecture (Coherency, bus interconnects, Security, arch evolution)

  • Good communication and work with minimal supervision

  • Collaborate with Perf, Design and System team stakeholders in developing solutions

  • Experience with Verilog, logic design principles with timing, area and power implications.

  • Experience in testplan development, UVM, will be a great asset

  • Understanding of interconnect protocols like AHB/AXI/ACE/ACE-Lite/CHI.

  • Good Understanding of concurrency, bandwidth, latency and system level aspects

title: Sr Eng/Lead Eng/Staff Eng - Hardware Design - Multiple positions
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. Qualcomm Cloud System Hardware and Validation Engineering develops cutting-edge rack level AI inference solutions for next generation liquid-cooled data centers. As part of its rapid expansion, the team is looking for experienced engineers to join and contribute to the next round of innovative AI products that Qualcomm intends to bring to the market.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will:

Design and develop motherboards/add in cards/modules for Qualcomm new AI System On Chip (So C)/System In Package (SIP). Primary responsibilities include working with cross functional teams (mechanical, thermal, SI, PTE, regulatory, validation, manufacturing, etc.) for execution of projects from concept to production. Support rack level design and integration of cards, servers and networking switches.

Principal Duties and RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Develops basic features and components of hardware designs in line with product proposals or roadmaps, under the supervision of more experienced engineers.

· Applies basic design rules and processes for electronic hardware, equipment, and/or integrated circuitry with minimal supervision from more experienced engineers.

· Reads device specification sheets and interprets basic details required to design various hardware features with minimal guidance from more experienced engineers.

· Evaluates devices and documents performance over various operating conditions and configurations.

· Assists in the assessment of common design features to identify potential flaws (e.g., electrical, mechanical, hardware), compatibility issues, and/or compliance issues under the supervision of more experienced engineers.

· Documents basic details about materials, components, chipsets, and assemblies for a device, and records important changes to design with minimal supervision from more experienced engineers.

· Troubleshoots basic issues with product designs.

· Provides reasonable schedule for own tasks to project lead.

· Develops understanding of Qualcomm products.

· Work with ODM on joint design, address technical issues and support mass production

· Seeks basic knowledge of industry trends, competitor products, and advances in various engineering fields from publicly available information; requires minimal consultation with more experienced engineers to understand and apply advanced concepts.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

· System/card/rack-level development, including architecture, design, validation, and deployment of enterprise-class hardware platforms. Strengths in any of the following areas:

title: Automotive cybersecurity engineer – Senior /Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Company:

General Summary:

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. Qualcomm is utilizing its traditional strengths in digital wireless technologies to play a central role in the evolution of automotive infotainment and autonomous driving. The Qualcomm Automotive Security team is engaged in offering optimized solutions built on Safety CPU cores, DSP, computer vision and machine learning algorithms for the Qualcomm ADAS/Autonomy/Infotainment systems architecture.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

We are seeking experienced engineers with strong expertise in automotive cybersecurity at the system and So C levels.

· Develop and deliver ISO/SAE 21434training, with emphasis on application of Qualcomm best practices.

· Facilitate and review TARA (Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment) and VARA (Vulnerability Analysis and Risk Assessment) activities.

· Independently conduct cybersecurity management system audits and product assessments against ISO/SAE 21434; provide actionable feedback, identify gaps, and track follow-up actions with internal teams.

· Collaborate closely with So C design teams, IP teams, third-party IP vendors, software teams, functional safety and cybersecurity managers, Quality teams, and customers to ensure effective deployment of defined cybersecurity processes.

· Participate in external and customer cybersecurity assessments, including support for corrective and preventive actions.

· Maintain strong awareness of automotive cybersecurity best practices, emerging standards, and regulatory trends; proactively influence stakeholders with data-driven insights to close gaps in a timely manner.

· Build and sustain effective working relationships with key stakeholders across Cybersecurity, Functional Safety, and Quality, supporting ongoing internal and external assessments.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/ Electronics and Communications Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

· 8+ years of Systems Engineering/VLSI design or related work experience.

· Knowledge of product development flow and validation.

· Experience in leading process audits and product assessments against ISO/SAE 21434 standard

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

· 5+ years of automotive experience with familiarity in Hardware development in the semiconductor industry, meeting ISO/SAE 21434 standard

· Familiarity with ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 automotive SOTIF standards is a plus.

· Lead auditor certification for ISO 9001/IATF 16949 is a plus.

title: Staff Engineer – Perception System Validation (XR Technologies)
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

At Qualcomm XR Research, we develop state-of-the-art XR technologies that enable exceptional AR/VR/MR user experiences.

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to own and drive validation of perception systems for XR (AR/VR/MR) technologies. This role focuses on validating SLAM and other perception algorithms, defining meaningful KPIs, building scalable test automation, and performing deep failure analysis. The role requires strong mathematical fundamentals, hands-on Python expertise, and the ability to communicate technical issues clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Perception & Algorithm Validation

· Validate SLAM (visual / visual-inertial / multi-sensor) and other algorithms across XR use cases.

· Design scenario-driven validation strategies covering accuracy, robustness, stability, and failure modes.

· Evaluate performance across sensors, calibrations, environments, and system configurations.

· Define and evolve perception KPIs (pose accuracy, drift, stability/jitter, robustness, reconstruction quality).

· Perform mathematical and statistical analysis of logs, trajectories, and 3D outputs.

· Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve test coverage, repeatability, and efficiency.

· Perform preliminary root-cause analysis of perception failures and regressions.

· Support algorithm and system teams with actionable debugging insights.

Required Skills & Qualifications

· Strong foundation in mathematics (linear algebra, geometry, probability, optimization).

· Strong proficiency in Python for automation, analysis, and tooling.

· Solid understanding of SLAM algorithms and perception pipelines.

· Strong knowledge of sensor calibration (camera, IMU, multi-sensor systems).

· Experience with large log analysis, offline processing, and metrics generation.

· Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly.

· Proven ability to work across teams and support stakeholder debugging needs.

Preferred

· 9+ years of relevant industry experience in perception systems, computer vision, robotics, or XR technologies.

· M.Tech / MS in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

· Experience with XR, AR/VR/MR, robotics, or autonomous systems.

· Familiarity with tools such as GTSAM, Ceres, Open CV, ROS, or similar libraries.

· Experience with ground-truth systems (motion capture, GNSS, fiducials).

· Experience influencing validation strategy at a system or org level.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

• 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

title: Chipset Systems Architect
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Chipset Architect, you will research, design, develop, simulate, and/or validate systems-level software, hardware, architecture, algorithms, and solutions that enables the development of cutting-edge technology. Qualcomm Systems Engineers collaborate across functional teams to meet and exceed system-level requirements and standards.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering
OR
Ph D in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Master's Degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field.

• 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

• Hands-on experience working in mobile, PC, XR, Wearable, Automotive, Consumer or Industrial Io T industry;

  • Experience with full product lifecycle from requirements gathering, prototype development, production, knowledge of PCB design flow, EDA tools, electrical and thermal simulations.

  • In depth knowledge of power delivery, PDN, component selection, tuning, Voltage regulators, PMICs, e BOM

  • Good knowledge of interfaces (USB, PCIe, SD/e MMC, UFS, LPDDRx, CSI, DSI, SPI, I2C, SPMI, Slimbus etc)

  • Good domain knowledge of 2 or more functional areas of So Cs such as Application Processor, Display, Graphics, Camera, Video, AI, Modem (4G/5G), WLAN, Power Management etc.

  • Working with a wide cross functional team comprising of various design and software teams, product management, reliability, functional safety, business, sales and customer engineering.

Principal Duties and RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Applies Systems knowledge and experience to research, design, develop, simulate, and/or validate systems-level software, hardware, architecture, algorithms, and solutions while ensuring system-level requirements and standards are met.

• Performs functional analysis to drive requirements and specifications and to define and align with standards for hardware and software.

• Develops and analyzes system level design including requirements, interface definition, functional/performance definition, and implementation of a new system or modification of an existing system.

• Collaborates with own team and other teams to complete project work, including implementing and testing features and verifying the accuracy of systems.

• Develops new and innovative ideas (e.g. IDFs) for a product or feature area.

• Drives triage of problems at the system level to determine root cause and presents results of testing and debugging to team members.

Level of Responsibility:

• Works independently with minimum supervision.

• Decision-making may affect work beyond immediate work group.

• Requires expert verbal and written communication skills to convey information. Will require basic negotiation, influence, tact, etc.

• Has a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to make key decisions).

• Tasks require multiple steps which can be performed in various orders; some planning, problem-solving, and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

title: Performance Benchmark– Server Platform - Engineer to Senior Staff Engineer
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering

General Summary:

Overview

Join Qualcomm’s Platform Performance Team to drive ARMv9 server‑class CPU performance across cloud and enterprise platforms.

In this role, you will own end‑to‑end benchmarking, regression tracking, system‑level performance analysis, and optimization to deliver industry‑leading results. You will work across hardware, firmware, OS, and software layers to measure, analyze, and improve performance, collaborating closely with kernel, compiler, silicon, and customer teams

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering
  • 3+ years of experience in performance engineering, system software, or related roles
  • Strong proficiency in Python and Bash for automation and data analysis
  • Working knowledge of C/C++ in performance‑critical environments
  • Familiarity with ARM‑based server platforms and Linux systems
  • Hands‑on experience running and analyzing CPU Server workloads SPEC CPU, SPECrate, and SPECjbb
  • Experience with performance tools such as perf, VTune, or equivalent
  • Exposure to Linux performance tuning and basic statistical analysis

Core Technical Skills

  • Strong foundation in CPU and system architecture, with an understanding of how modern processors execute workloads and how architectural choices impact performance at scale.
  • Awareness of microarchitectural behavior, including how core execution, caching, and control mechanisms influence efficiency, latency, and throughput across diverse workloads.
  • Solid grasp of memory and platform architecture, with the ability to reason about data movement, locality, bandwidth and latency trade‑offs, and system‑level placement effects in complex environments.
  • Familiarity with ARM‑based platforms, including exposure to contemporary ARM architectures and an appreciation of how architectural extensions affect performance characteristics.
  • Working knowledge of Linux internals, particularly how operating system behavior influences CPU utilization, memory performance, and I/O efficiency.
  • Exposure to virtualization technologies, with an understanding of how virtualized environments can impact performance measurement and tuning.
  • Experience with performance benchmarking and analysis, including designing meaningful experiments, ensuring result consistency, identifying trends over time, and applying sound analytical judgment to interpret data.

Key Responsibilities

Benchmarking & Characterization

  • Execute and analyze SPEC CPU, SPECrate, SPECjbb, and representative cloud or microservice workloads
  • Characterize CPU, cache, memory, NUMA, and I/O behavior on ARMv9 server platforms
  • Understand what each benchmark measures and how system configuration impacts results
  • Experience with ARMv9 platforms, UEFI/BIOS, PCIe/CXL, NUMA.
  • Proficient with perf, VTune, ARM Streamline,TMA.
  • Linux performance tuning and statistical analysis experience

Performance Analysis & Root Cause Debugging

  • Identify CPU‑bound, memory‑bound, and system‑level bottlenecks
  • Use PMU counters, profiling tools, and system traces to debug regressions
  • Analyze CPI trends, cache misses, memory access patterns, and scheduler effects
  • Form data‑driven hypotheses and validate them through controlled experiments
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally to drive fixes and verify improvements

Regression Tracking & Monitoring

  • Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for server workloads
  • Automate performance regression detection in CI/CD environments
  • Track performance changes across software, firmware (UEFI/BIOS), and hardware updates

Optimization

  • Tune Linux kernel parameters, system configuration, and benchmark settings
  • Evaluate compiler flags and toolchains for performance impact
  • Optimize code paths where applicable using ARMv9 features and SVE/SVE2

Customer & Ecosystem Validation

  • Validate performance for hyperscalers, Kubernetes, and enterprise workloads
  • Support OEM/ODM benchmarking, customer evaluations, and field issues
  • Help explain performance behavior using clear, data‑backed analysis

Automation & Infrastructure

  • Develop and maintain automated benchmarking frameworks
  • Build scalable testbeds for repeatable performance testing
  • Contribute to data collection, visualization, and reporting pipelines

Desired Attributes

  • Strong analytical and data‑driven problem‑solving mindset
  • Ability to explain performance trends clearly using metrics
  • Practical, structured approach to debugging complex system issues
  • Curiosity and willingness to dig across system layers
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Passion for performance engineering and system optimization

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

jobDescription:
Company:

Job Area:

General Summary:

Job Overview:

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G - ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in. We are investing in several supporting technologies including 4G, 5G, Edge Computing, and Deep Learning.

The Qualcomm AI team is developing hardware and software for Machine Learning solutions spanning the data center, edge, infrastructure, automotive markets and beyond. We are seeking ambitious, bright and innovative engineers with experience in Machine learning frameworks, compiler technology, vectorization and optimization, and machine learning toolchains.

Job activities span the whole product life cycle from early design to commercial deployment. The environment is fast-paced and requires cross-functional interaction on a daily basis so good communication, planning and execution skills are a must.

We are looking to staff engineers at multiple levels in systems & software, integration and test. Details of one of the roles we are looking to staff are listed below.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Research, design, develop, enhance, and implement the different components of machine learning framework, compilers based on performance and code-size needs of the customer workloads and benchmarks.
- Analyze software requirements, determine the feasibility of design within the given constraints, consult with architecture and HW engineers, and implement software solutions best suited for Qualcomm's SOCs.
- Analyze and identify system level integration issues, interface with the software development, integration and test teams.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
- 8+ years Systems Engineering or related work experience.


Preferred Qualifications

- Has internal working knowledge of Machine learning frameworks like Pytorch, Tensorflow.

- Has experience in model level optimization using techniques like torch compile.

- LLVM or any industrial strength compiler development experience is a plus.

- Experience in MLIR is a plus.
- Knowledge of the structure and function of the compiler internals.
- Hands on experience writing SIMD and/or multi-threaded high-performance code is a plus.
- Hands-on experience implementing DSP Kernels a plus

- Experience in Programming in memory is a plus.
- Hands-on Experience in C/C++, Python development (5+ years)
- Hands-on Experience with Object Orientated Design, TDD development solutions such as Google Test etc. (4+ years)
- Experience with Source Code and Configuration management tools, git knowledge is required
- Willingness to work in a cohesive software development environment with ability to work on low level implementation (code & test) and interfacing with hardware and simulators
- Experience in neural network architectures + ML compiler workload synthesis, a plus
- Prior working experience of hardware accelerators and hardware software co-design
- Experience in using C++ 14/17 (advanced features)
- Experience at both the firmware (RTOS) and system level (Linux) in SOC
- Experience of profiling software and optimization techniques
- Passion to drive to develop leading-edge "deep learning" framework and algorithms working on mobile and embedded platforms.

title: Sr Lead Engineer - Hardware Design
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Ph D in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field.

• 5+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
• 2+ years of experience with circuit design (e.g., digital, analog, RF).

• 2+ years of experience utilizing schematic capture and circuit simulation software.

• 2+ years of experience with hardware design and measurement instruments such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, RF tools, etc.

• 1+ year in a technical leadership role with or without direct reports.

Principal Duties and RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Leverages Hardware knowledge and experience to plan, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems.

• Integrates features and functionality into hardware designs in line with proposals or roadmaps.

title: Director, Engineering
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Test Engineering

General Summary:

Job Overview:

The Qualcomm Cloud Computing team is developing hardware and software for Machine Learning solutions spanning the data center, edge, infrastructure, automotive market. We are seeking ambitious, bright, and innovative engineers with experience in machine learning framework development. Job activities span the whole product life cycle from early design to commercial deployment. The environment is fast-paced and requires cross-functional interaction daily so good communication, planning and execution skills are a must.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze software requirements, determine the feasibility of design within the given constraints, consult with architecture and HW engineers, and implement software solutions best suited for Qualcomm's SOCs.

  • Analyze and identify system level issues, interface with the software development, integration, and test teams

  • Lead high performing teams towards system design and deliverables.

  • Proven track record of leading teams in Machine learning software engineering.

  • Strong foundation of Mathematical modeling of problems and linear algebra, coupled with state of the art algorithms in ML/AI space.

  • Improve and optimize key Deep Learning models on Qualcomm AI 100.

  • Build deep learning framework extensions for Qualcomm AI 100 in upstream open-source repositories.

  • Collaborate and interact with internal teams to analyze and optimize training and inference for deep learning.

  • Build software tools and ecosystem around AI SW Stack.

  • Work on v LLM, Triton, Execu Torch, Inductor, Torch Dynamo to build abstraction layers for inference accelerator.

  • Optimize workloads for both scale-up (multi-So C) and scale-out (multi-card) systems.

  • Optimize the entire deep learning pipeline including graph compiler integration.

  • Apply knowledge of software engineering best practices.

Desirable Skills and Aptitudes

  • Deep Learning experience or knowledge – LLMs, Natural Language Processing, Vision, Audio, Recommendation systems.

  • Knowledge of the structure and function of different components of Pytorch, Tensor Flow software stacks.

  • Excellent C/C++/Python programming and software design skills, including debugging, performance analysis, and test design.

  • Ability to work independently, define requirements and scope, and lead your own development effort.

  • Well versed with open-source development practices.

  • Strong developer with a research mindset – strives to innovate.

  • Avid problem solver – should be able to find solutions to key engineering and domain problems.

  • Knowledge of tiling and scheduling a Machine learning operator is a plus.

  • Experience in using C++ 14 (advanced features)

  • Experience of profiling software and optimization techniques

  • Hands on experience writing SIMD and/or multi-threaded high-performance code is a plus.

  • Experience of ML compiler, Auto-code generation (using MLIR) is a plus.

  • Experiences to run workloads on large scale heterogeneous clusters is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience with CUDA, CUDNN is a plus.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's / Masters/ PHD degree in Engineering, Machine learning/ AI, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

  • 15+ years Software Engineering or related work experience.

  • 15+ years’ experience with Programming Language such as C++, Python.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Test Engineering or related work experience.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Test Engineering or related work experience.

• 5+ year of work experience with Software Test or System Test, developing and automating test plans, and/or tools (e.g., Source Code Control Systems, Continuous Integration Tools, and Bug Tracking Tools).

title: Lead Engineer Senior - Performance Modeling
jobDescription:
Company:

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary:

Qualcomm is the world's leading developer of next-generation of always connected Edge-AI processing technology and is committed to building a world-class organization that will lead the industry.

Be part of the team developing next generation Audio and Always On / Edge AI subsystems and platforms. The ASIC Audio/Edge AI Systems Engineer is responsible for system architecture definition activities supporting a sophisticated multimedia Low Power Audio/Edge AI subsystem across a broad range of mobile, XR, compute, and automotive products.

Candidates will be responsible for all aspects of the ASIC hardware architecture definition/validation including the following:

  • Owning end to end system architecture

  • Capturing detailed technology requirements working closely with product, hardware and software engineering teams

  • Developing detailed ASIC system architectures to support requirements and authoring subsystem hardware specifications

  • Defining architecture validation plans and reviewing development results

Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Ph D in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
